result.stdout:
avalonia-remote - Avalonia Remote Control client

Protocol: 1.0

Usage:
  avalonia-remote --help
  avalonia-remote adb list
  avalonia-remote adb connect --serial <serial> --package <package> [--launch-package] [--host-port <port>]
  avalonia-remote adb connect --serial <serial> --device-port <port> --token <token> [--host-port <port>]
  avalonia-remote adb cleanup --serial <serial> --host-port <port>

Omit --host-port on connect to allocate an available port. Package launch is opt-in.

Connection modes:
  local    Loopback debuggee connection.
  network  LAN/TLS debuggee connection.
  adb      Android emulator/device connection through adb forward.

Current status:
  Desktop UI, live remote view, TLS certificate acceptance, Android bridge transport, and ADB list/connect/cleanup are available.
